DOP: pabba n. [ S. parvan], 1. a knot (of a stalk); a joint; Abh 600 (~aṃ tu phalu gaṇṭhi); 889 (sākhādiphalumhi ~aṃ); Vin IV 35, 8 (ucchu veḷu naḷo yāni vā pan’ aññāni pi atthi ~e jāyanti ~e sañjāyanti etaṃ phaḷubījaṃ nāma); S IV 171, 20 (~esu sati sammiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati); Sp 922, 6 (ekissā aṅguliyā tīṇi ~āni); Th-a I 172, 6 (pasākhajāto ti … sākhānaṃ pi ~e ~e uppanna-anusākho); 240, 22 (selo hi sandhisaṅkhātehi ~ehi ṭhitattā pabbato ti); Pj II 245, 12 (tāni tāni ~āni sammiñjeti pasāreti ca); Paṭis-a 677, 20 (maṇimayāni pattāni suvaṇṇamayāni ~āni ahesuṃ); — ifc see ūru-; — kāḷā pabbā ca in Ee, Se at Ja V 69, 8*: read kāḷāpabbā va or kāḷapabbā va with Be, Ce; cf 69, 24´ : kāḷapabbavallisadisāni te aṅgāni); — see also āsītika- ( sv āsītika 2 ), kāḷā-; — 2. a section, division; Vism 240, 10 (imesaṃ cuddasannaṃ ~ānaṃ vasena kāyagatāsati kammaṭṭhānaṃ niddiṭṭhaṃ); Ps II 92, 3 (idaṃ ~aṃ asatipabbaṃ nāma); Vibh-a 268, 17 (imasmiṃ pana ~e suddhavipassanā va kathitā ti); — 3. the days of the four changes of the moon; a festival; Abh 889 (tithibhede ca … ~aṃ); — ifc see utu-; — °- vāta , m. , pain in the joints; Vin I 205, 25 (āyasmato Pilindavacchassa ~o hoti; Sp 1091, 27 : ~o hotī ti pabbe pabbe vāto vijjhati).
